projects.title: Energy Efficient College Building
projects.subtitle: Integrated planning, structural design & energy optimisation
projects.scope: Planning · Structural Design · Energy Simulation · Estimation · G+2 · ~24,000 sq.ft
projects.summary: Designed an energy-efficient G+2 educational facility using an integrated BIM workflow, covering site analysis, architectural planning, structural design, energy optimisation, cost estimation, and visualization.
projects.overview: Final-year project focused on developing a sustainable institutional building with reduced energy demand while maintaining structural safety and functional efficiency. The workflow progressed from site assessment to analysis, simulation, and documentation following NBC, KMBR, and relevant IS codes.
objectives: Minimize operational energy demand using passive design strategies
Ensure structural safety and code compliance
Generate accurate quantity take-offs and cost estimation

approach.title: Site Analysis & Planning
approach.desc: Studied orientation, solar exposure, and wind conditions to optimise building placement.

approach.title: Architectural BIM Modeling
approach.desc: Developed architectural model with functional zoning and shading strategies.

approach.title: Structural Analysis
approach.desc: Analyzed structural elements in ETABS for safety under design loads.

approach.title: Energy Simulation
approach.desc: Evaluated thermal performance using Green Building Studio.

approach.title: Documentation
approach.desc: Prepared drawings, schedules, estimates, and visualisations.

approach.title: Area Analysis
approach.desc: Total Built-up Area: ~24,000 sq.ft across G+2 floors.

highlights: Coordinated BIM model as a single source of project data
Design compliant with NBC, KMBR, and IS codes
projects.outcome: Demonstrated integrated BIM workflow combining sustainability, structural safety, and functional planning. Achieved significant energy savings potential.
